Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick onboarding queue. Attached is our completed onboarding form (NimbleGrid_Onboarding_Form.pdf). We anticipate initial consumption tied to a pilot integration in Q4 and would like a provisional PO and a default spend cap to avoid provisioning delays.

Quick details:
- Estimated first-month spend: $42,000
- Expected steady-state monthly spend (post-pilot): $18k–25k
- Primary SKU mapping: IMPL-EDGE-01 (ingest), ANALYTICS-02 (queries) — see attached CSV for the line-item breakdown.

Can you confirm:
1) Timeline for provisional PO issuance?
2) Whether finance needs the W9 now or can accept it as a Drive link?
3) Any line-item code changes we should make to match Redwood's chart-of-accounts?

Attachments: NimbleGrid_Onboarding_Form.pdf, lineitems_mapping.csv

Thanks,

Hi Sophie — thanks for the form and the CSV. I looped in Dylan (vendor ops) and Vanessa (finance intake) to speed this along.

Next steps from our side:
- We need a completed W-9 (PDF) for Finance to create a vendor record in Coupa. A Drive link is OK if it is a signed PDF; otherwise please attach directly.
- I can request a provisional PO (one-off) for the pilot. That typically takes 24–48h after vendor record is created.
- Please confirm whether the two SKUs you listed map to separate GL codes or should be combined under a single billing line. Finance prefers as few line items as possible for the provisional PO.

If you can upload the W-9 and confirm SKU-to-GL mapping in the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNimbleGridOnboard), I will submit the PO request and follow up with the PO number.

Regards,

> Hi Sophie — thanks for the form and the CSV. I looped in Dylan (vendor ops) and Vanessa (finance intake) to speed this along.

Thanks, Olga. Sophie — quick internal request from ops/engineering side: the pilot will spike ingest throughput in week 2, so Finance should expect a short-term bump. Can we set an initial spend cap of $75,000 on the provisional PO so we don't need to interrupt the pilot for a mid-cycle adjustment? Vanessa — can you confirm whether Finance can provision a provisional PO with a temporary $75k spend band and auto-notify us at 80%?

Also, I noticed in the CSV that ANALYTICS-02 and IMPL-EDGE-01 were listed as separate lines but both billed to the same product family. If possible, consolidate them into one billable line "NIMBLE-PLATFORM" for the provisional PO to simplify accounting; we can split them into discrete GLs during the next billing cycle. I've attached a cleaned mapping (lineitems_mapping.csv - updated).

Summary and closure:
- Provisional PO: PO-RED-2026-9317 (pilot)
- Provisional spend cap: $75,000 (auto-alert at 80% configured)
- Billable line for provisional PO: NIMBLE-PLATFORM (Finance will split to GLs on month-end if needed)
- Attachments: PO stub (PO-RED-2026-9317-stub.pdf) uploaded to Drive, will route to NimbleGrid billing contact.

Next steps (action owners):
- NimbleGrid: use PO-RED-2026-9317 on all pilot invoices, and submit itemized invoices referencing the NIMBLE-PLATFORM line. (Sophie)
- Vendor Ops (Dylan): monitor pilot consumption; alert Olga and Vanessa if forecast exceeds $65k mid-cycle.
- Finance (Vanessa): finalize vendor record, confirm GL coding by next Wednesday and move to final PO if steady-state spend stabilizes.

If you want the PO fully signed via DocuSign, we can spin up the envelope; otherwise the provisional PO stub is sufficient for AP to match invoices. Link: https://docusign.com/links/RED-9317-provisional-po
